propositions: DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX bound set at 1800s (1.5x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) is undersized and misses burst scenarios by 10-130s, causing unnecessary LLM-Review interrupts during heavy landing activity.

Four autodeploy review interrupts on 2026-08-12 fired because deferred_for overshot the 1800s bound (1810s, 1820s, 1810s, 1930s), killing in-flight reviews that would have completed within a larger bound.
Raising DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX to 2400s (2.0x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) absorbs the observed 10-130s overshoots and prevents the four Aug-12 interrupt firings without fixing underlying saturation scenarios.
The deferral bound must remain pegged to REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS as a fixed multiple rather than a free literal, so that bound adjustments self-propagate when the app's per-review cap changes.
Saturated-episode behavior where in_flight never reaches zero is not fixed by this raise and remains a separate defect; bound increase only defers the same kill under sustained pipelining.
Test assertion must be tightened from bound >= 1.0x to bound >= 2.0x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS to enforce the new relationship and prevent future drift.
